items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: There's a Henry Baptiste back in the days that played bass.

ctx.x: Okay. And then, oh, there's some other, okay, Earl Baptiste's father played banjo. His name was Baptiste also. There's a Henry Baptiste back in the days that played bass. And, man, oh, I guess we could go on and on. Baptiste's a big family of musicians. Generically, we must be related somewhere. Okay. Or somehow.
Now, what was your father's name?
